baseline.advice: To attract Sydney travelers, emphasize your property’s proximity to An Bang Beach and the UNESCO Old Town, and highlight any Australian‑friendly touches such as English‑speaking staff, Vegemite‑stocked mini‑bars, or complimentary sunscreen. Use targeted ads on Facebook and Instagram that showcase sunset photos and guest testimonials from Aussies, and consider offering a “Sydney‑Special” package that includes a free surf lesson or a guided bike tour of the countryside. Partner with Australian travel blogs and influencers to generate authentic word‑of‑mouth, and encourage guests to leave reviews on TripAdvisor and Google mentioning their hometown. Finally, ensure your booking engine displays prices in AUD and offers flexible cancellation policies that match the expectations of Australian travelers.
